title: Beyond Keywords
description: Turn shopper questions into a practical semantic SEO plan for one category and its products.

sections.heading: Map the questions behind the purchase
sections.body: Start with a category and three to five products. Use the prompt and journey worksheet to identify what a shopper needs to know before comparing options.

sections.heading: Connect questions, attributes and pages
sections.body: Build an entity-and-attribute map, assign a clear job to each page, and identify where first-hand knowledge would make an answer more useful.

sections.heading: Turn the map into a brief
sections.body: Use the tracking, prioritisation and one-page brief exercises to choose an achievable next step. The workbook ends with a thirty-day plan you can adapt to your own site.

methodology: A practical workbook using Fieldnorth, a fictional outdoor retailer, as an illustrative example. Exercises move from questions and entity mapping to page planning, evidence gathering and prioritisation.
limitations: The examples are fictional and do not report client results. Verify all product specifications against your own source data before using them. The workbook is a planning tool, not a promise of search or AI visibility gains.
